plan.name: Search for egg on shelves and clean it
plan.strategy: Assume the egg is on one of the shelves and clean it using the sink.
steps: Check if there is an egg on shelf 1.
If not, go to shelf 2, then shelf 3.
Take the egg from the shelf where it is found.
Put the clean egg in microwave 1.
